request.prompt: Create one production candidate bitmap for the Armax Relay Clash 2D fighting-game art catalog, faithfully studying the supplied original game-model reference. A single full-body subject only, isolated on a genuinely transparent RGBA background, no scenery, no floor plane or ground shadow, no lettering, no caption, no border, no diagram, no contact sheet, no repeated views, no logo added outside the subject. Clean readable silhouette, detailed realistic game-model materials, restrained neutral studio illumination. Show a three-quarter front view with the subject oriented toward screen-right, camera level and minimal perspective distortion. The complete head, equipment, limbs and feet must fit; leave at least six percent transparent breathing room on every side. Preserve the reference's real anatomy, panel construction, proportions, asymmetric equipment and exact costume palette. Do not redesign or modernize. Subject: ONE FENRIS quadrupedal security mech from Mass Effect 2. The supplied sheet shows unrelated tall humanoid views on the LEFT and the required LOW FOUR-LEGGED ROBOT on the RIGHT: reproduce ONLY that compact quadruped with the same rounded heavy shell and unusual downward angled head plate. Four short articulated black mechanical legs, broad compact dark body below a smooth curved off-white/light-grey back shell with small rectangular top protrusions, pale arching haunch armor and circular side joint covers with bright red rings. The front head is a LARGE blunt sloping OVAL SHIELDLIKE plate in a pale rim, face nearly as deep as the body, dark center displaying TWO bright RED OPEN RINGS stacked vertically as in the foreground view of the source, with a small red upper sensor. It is not a realistic dog head: NO muzzle, NO canine teeth, NO ears, NO organic fur, NO tail, NO invented gun. Preserve the reference's low body depth, broad oval front sensor plate and short squat piston limbs, all FOUR mechanical feet visibly articulated and planted with modest stagger so they can be counted. Three-quarter front view facing screen-right. Use a wider canvas suitable to this low quadruped; leave six percent space around all extremities. Match the smooth white shell, black mechanisms and restrained red optics of this exact ME2 model.
